text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Machikane Fukukitaru demonstrated her true 
capabilities and delivered results at the 
Kokura Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As promised, after savoring tonkotsu ramen 
at the Hakata Food Stalls— one of 
Fukuoka's two great sacred spots— she 
brought up a race she wanted to enter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not decided by fortune-telling, but the 
race she herself truly wishes to run is 
the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not relying on luck like in the Takarazuka 
Kinen, but earning the votes through her 
own strength to run... Matikanefukukitaru 
burned with determination.
